subject: Request: Executive sign-off — tailored onboarding + premium support concession for Olive Health
messages:
Date: 2028-05-19T08:12:00-07:00
From: Anna Li <anna@olivehealth.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Subject: Tailored onboarding & premium support for Olive Health - pilot deal

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with performance and the routing options you showed. We have internal buy-in to run a six-month pilot across our cardiology and endocrinology clinics but Procurement is pushing back on the implementation cost and the premium support line item.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood include Premium Support (P1/P2 coverage) for the first 6 months as part of the pilot bundle? That helps us move quickly and give a measurable ROI during pilot.
- We need an adjusted SOW that includes a custom HL7/FHIR connector and a guaranteed integration window (160 hours max). Procurement is asking for a one-time onboarding credit to reduce out-of-pocket cost.

Attached is our draft SOW and a brief list of expected EMR endpoints. Would appreciate a high-level commercial concession to take to Procurement by EOD Tuesday. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Anna Li
Head of Digital Programs
Olive Health

Attachments: SOW-OliveHealth-v1.docx (draft), EMR-endpoints.csv
Date: 2028-05-19T09:03:00-07:00
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Subject: Fwd: Tailored onboarding & premium support for Olive Health - pilot deal — request for exec concession

Team — forwarding Olive's note. Quick summary and proposal:

Summary:
- 6-month pilot with Olive Health covering two specialties
- Requires custom HL7/FHIR connector; estimated 120–160 engineering hours
- Procurement requests inclusion of Premium Support for first 6 months and a one-time onboarding credit to reduce initial cost exposure

My proposed concession (for executive sign-off):
- Include Premium Support (Standard P1/P2) at no charge for first 6 months
- Provide a one-time onboarding credit of $35,000 applied to the SOW (to land the pilot)
- Cap custom integration work at 160 hours; bill any hours over cap at a discounted rate of $175/hr
- Require DocuSign-signed SOW and milestone acceptance criteria tied to go-live (to protect revenue recognition)

Rationale: closes a strategic pilot with a national provider, strong motion to enterprise, likely expansion within 12 months. Margin hit on the front-end, but signed pilot increases probability of expansion and renewal.

Please review and indicate: approve as-is / reduce credit / change hour cap / legal redlines. I can reply to Anna with a firm offer once we align.

Quoted below for context.

To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Fwd: Tailored onboarding & premium support for Olive Health - pilot deal — request for exec concession

Sean — I reviewed the account and pipeline. Olive Health is a strategic target with clear expansion signals (three other lines of business are evaluating). I recommend we approve a concession but tighten the numbers to protect gross margin. Proposed approved terms: 

- Approve inclusion of Premium Support for the first 6 months (trial), contingent on a signed 12-month commercial contract for production following pilot OR a formal extension approval.
- Reduce onboarding credit to $25,000 (one-time).
- Cap integration at 140 hours. Any work > 140 hours billed at $200/hr.
- Require documented go/no-go milestone at 90 days and objectives tied to data sync and latency targets.

Commercial ask: Sean, make sure Procurement accepts the milestone gating and the post-pilot production commitment. If we get a firm 12-month commitment, we can authorize a larger credit at renewal as incentive.

I think this is a reasonable trade-off to land the pilot while holding to our average onboarding margin. Copying Neha for finance read on the cash flow impact. Karthik, please flag any legal concerns with the integration SLA/redlines (IP, data handling).

-Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Marissa — escalating for final executive sign-off. Olive needs a firm answer to share with Procurement no later than EOD today. Below is a concise decision request and the proposed (negotiated) terms.

Proposal for approval (final ask):
- Premium Support included at no charge for first 6 months (approved by Marissa)
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (approved by Marissa)
- Integration scope: capped at 140 hours; any additional hours billed at $200/hr (cap exception must be pre-authorized by exec)
- SOW to include milestones at 30/90/180 days with acceptance criteria; DocuSign to be used; Redwood to retain usage and audit logs for 12 months per normal policy

Impact: estimated immediate ARR risk is minimal (pilot revenue remains), one-time cost of $25k and 140 hours of engineering (equates to an estimated $38k cost at blended rate). Forecasted 12-month expansion probability > 60% based on inbound interest.

Attachments for reference: SOW-OliveHealth-v2.pdf (updated with 140-hr cap), discount-matrix.xlsx, onboarding-playbook.odt

Decision options: Approve / Approve with change (specify) / Deny. If approved, I will send a final offer to Anna and route the SOW to Karthik for redline confirmation and to Neha for finance sign-off.

Thanks — need a response by 17:00 PT to keep Procurement on schedule.

Best,
